verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single homepage line describing a guided flow: the user describes a task, reviews the plan and cost, approves the run, and gets a trained model. That suggests delegation to a built-in assistant, but only for fine-tuning. Tool calling and agent-building docs cover what customers build on the API, not an assistant inside the product, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an in-product AI assistant, delegation beyond fine-tuning (e.g., deployments, debugging, model selection), detail on how the assistant plans and executes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
